name: v2.0.8-rolling
body:
This release includes the following changes:

* Fix Arduino due build (https://github.com/micro-ROS/micro_ros_arduino/pull/1481)
* Fix teensy patch and compiler (https://github.com/micro-ROS/micro_ros_arduino/pull/1484)
* Fix unsigned comparison (https://github.com/micro-ROS/micro_ros_arduino/pull/1658)
* Add build target for ESP32S3 (https://github.com/micro-ROS/micro_ros_arduino/pull/1801)
* Fix `time.h` import, add Arduino UNO R4 minima (USB), Arduino UNO R4 WiFi (USB and WiFi), Arduino Giga R1 (USB and WiFi)  (https://github.com/micro-ROS/micro_ros_arduino/pull/1863)
* Add Arduino Opta support (https://github.com/micro-ROS/micro_ros_arduino/pull/1876)
* Bump CI runner to Ubuntu 22.04  (https://github.com/micro-ROS/micro_ros_arduino/pull/1969)

name: v2.0.6-iron
body:
Initial release for ROS2 Iron!

Updates and fixes added on this distro:
- Add empty set_atomically parameter service (https://github.com/ros2/rclc/pull/354)
  - Related issue: https://github.com/micro-ROS/micro-ROS-Agent/issues/195
- Update service typesupport (https://github.com/micro-ROS/rosidl_typesupport_microxrcedds/pull/62)

name: v2.0.6-humble
body:
- Added Teensy 4.1 mac address getter to Ethernet publisher example  (#1074)
- Fix ethernet udp ping agent (#1094)
- Added Wio Terminal Support (#1284)
- Bug fixing:
  - Fix parameter change event (https://github.com/ros2/rclc/pull/310)
  - Fix wait_session_status listen timeout (https://github.com/eProsima/Micro-XRCE-DDS-Client/pull/322)
  - Fix memory release on entities creation (https://github.com/micro-ROS/rmw_microxrcedds/pull/280)
  - Fix get_actual_qos methods (https://github.com/micro-ROS/rmw_microxrcedds/pull/292)

name: v2.0.5-humble
body:
Initial release for ROS2 Humble!

New functionality added on this distro:
- Added micro-ROS Action server (https://github.com/ros2/rclc/pull/170) 
- Mayor refactor to micro-ROS parameter server (https://github.com/ros2/rclc/pull/274)

name: v2.0.5-galactic
body:
- Added [Hard liveliness check](https://discourse.ros.org/t/hard-liveliness-check-in-micro-ros/24891) (https://github.com/eProsima/Micro-XRCE-DDS-Client/pull/316).
- PlatformIO has been deprecated (https://github.com/micro-ROS/micro_ros_arduino/pull/957) in favor of [micro_ros_platformio](https://github.com/micro-ROS/micro_ros_platformio).
- Updated reconnection example (https://github.com/micro-ROS/micro_ros_arduino/pull/913)
- Improvements on performance
- Bug fixing:
  - Fix error return on topic and types name length (https://github.com/micro-ROS/rmw_microxrcedds/pull/254)
    - Related issue: https://github.com/micro-ROS/rmw_microxrcedds/issues/253
  - Fix serialization bug on bounded arrays (https://github.com/micro-ROS/rosidl_typesupport_microxrcedds/pull/46)
  - Fix on lifecycle package (https://github.com/ros2/rclc/pull/279)
    - Related issue: https://github.com/micro-ROS/micro_ros_arduino/issues/907

- PlatformIO has been deprecated (https://github.com/micro-ROS/micro_ros_arduino/pull/957) in favor of [micro_ros_platformio](https://github.com/micro-ROS/micro_ros_platformio).

  - Fix serialization bug on bounded arrays (https://github.com/micro-ROS/rosidl_typesupport_microxrcedds/pull/46)
  - Fix on lifecycle package (https://github.com/ros2/rclc/pull/279)
    - Related issue: https://github.com/micro-ROS/micro_ros_arduino/issues/907

name: v0.0.1
body:
Initial support for micro-ROS and Arduino IDE on the following platforms:

| Board                                                                    | Min version | State      | Details                                                                                             | Prebuild meta        |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------- | ---------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------- |
| [OpenCR](https://emanual.robotis.com/docs/en/parts/controller/opencr10/) | v1.4.16     | Supported  | [Based on custom board](https://emanual.robotis.com/docs/en/parts/controller/opencr10/#arduino-ide) | `colcon.meta`        |
| [Teensy 4.0](https://www.pjrc.com/store/teensy40.html)                   | v1.8.5      | Not tested | [Based on Teensyduino](https://www.pjrc.com/teensy/td_download.html)                                | `colcon.meta`        |
| [Teensy 4.1](https://www.pjrc.com/store/teensy41.html)                   | v1.8.5      | Supported  | [Based on Teensyduino](https://www.pjrc.com/teensy/td_download.html)                                | `colcon.meta`        |
| [Teensy 3.2/3.1](https://www.pjrc.com/store/teensy32.html)               | v1.8.5      | Supported  | [Based on Teensyduino](https://www.pjrc.com/teensy/td_download.html)                                | `colcon_lowmem.meta` |
